title.en: Early China · tradition, archaeology and written evidence
title.zh: 早期中国 · 传世叙述、考古与文字证据

summary.en: Compare Xia’s received chronology, Erlitou’s material remains, Shang royal centers, Yin Xu inscriptions and Zhou regional context. The accompanying early-China guide treats Yu/Shun without invented reign dates.
summary.zh: 比较夏的传统纪年、二里头物质遗存、商的王室中心、殷墟文字与周的区域背景；配套早期中国指南不为虞舜虚构在位年代。

questions.en: What can a received text, an archaeological site and a dated source outline each establish?
questions.zh: 传世文本、考古遗址和有年代的来源轮廓，各能证明什么？

questions.en: Why does a possible Xia identification differ from an oracle-bone inscription at Yin Xu?
questions.zh: 可能的夏身份判断，与殷墟甲骨铭刻的证据有何不同？

activity.en: Open the early-China guide. Separate the undated Yu/Shun tradition, conventional dynastic dates, archaeological phases and mapped source years. Explain one unresolved identification.
activity.zh: 打开早期中国指南，区分未独立定年的虞舜传统、王朝常用纪年、考古阶段和轮廓来源年代，解释一项未定的身份对应。

evidencePolicy: Questions are editorial prompts; linked records and the early-China guide disclose evidence and its limits.
